name: Formula Blur Race VR
summary:
Formula Blur Race VR puts you in the cockpit of an open-wheel race car where every power-up is a weapon. Reach out, grab the wheel with both hands and turn it to steer. The right trigger is your throttle, the left trigger brakes.

COLLECT, ATTACK, DEFEND
• Drive through glowing crystals to pick up power-ups and carry up to three at a time
• Flick the right stick to choose one and press A to use it
• Lock on to the car ahead, watch for incoming missiles and strike back
